item.summary: The National Land Monetization Corporation (NLMC), under the Department of Public Enterprises (DPE), Ministry of Finance, Government of India, successfully conducted Day 1 of the e-auction of premium land parcels belonging to Rashtriya Ispat Nigam Limited (RINL), the corporate entity operating Visakhapatnam Steel Plant. item.title: NLMC’s first end-to-end e-auction of RINL land parcels generates ₹366.33 Crore in successful bids on Day 1, 150 plots sold
